inputSpec.name: plots
inputSpec.label: log2 AF ratio plots
inputSpec.help: Generate plots showing histograms of log2 AF ratios. One plot per sample will be generated.

inputSpec.name: min_af
inputSpec.label: Minimum VAF
inputSpec.help: Minimum VAF in both samples for a variant to be informative.

inputSpec.name: min_dp
inputSpec.label: Minimum read depth
inputSpec.help: Minimum read depth (`FORMAT/DP`) to retain a variant. The filter expression is DP < min_dp, so `DP=99` is retained by default - this matches the clinical pipeline expression `FORMAT/DP<99`.

inputSpec.name: max_gnomad
inputSpec.label: Maximum GnomAD AF
inputSpec.help: Exclude variants with gnomAD AF greater than, or equal to, this value. Very common variants (AF > 0.40) produce false 2:1 ratio signals when one sample is hom-alt and the other is het. Set to 1.0 to disable.

inputSpec.name: min_shared
inputSpec.label: Minimum shared variants
inputSpec.help: Minimum number of informative shared variants required before assessing a pair.

inputSpec.name: freemix_threshold
inputSpec.label: Minimum FREEMIX threshold
inputSpec.help: Minimum recipient FREEMIX fraction (0–1) required for flagging.

inputSpec.name: non_unity_count
inputSpec.label: Non-unity count threshold
inputSpec.help: Flag a pair if the non-unity peak contains at least this many variants.

inputSpec.name: n_shared_z
inputSpec.label: Z-score threshold for number of shared variants
inputSpec.help: Flag a pair only if the within-run z-score of shared-variant count meets or exceeds this threshold (computed across all pairs in the run). Flagging occurs only when the `-inon_unity_count` threshold is also met.

inputSpec.name: max_output
inputSpec.label: Maximum output limit
inputSpec.help: Maximum number of flagged pairs to write detail TSVs and plots for, ranked by non_unity_count. Set to 0 for no limit.

inputSpec.name: force_refilter
inputSpec.label: Force refiltering
inputSpec.help: Re-run filtering even if filtered VCFs already exist.

outputSpec.name: matrix
outputSpec.label: matrix
outputSpec.help: Matrix of shared variants across pairs.

outputSpec.name: filter_jsons
outputSpec.label: Filtered VCF JSON statistics
outputSpec.help: JSON showing the values of the `pass_only`, `min_dp`, `min_af`, and `max_gnomad` submitted to contamination-screen.py for each sample.

outputSpec.name: flagged_pairs
outputSpec.label: Flagged-pair outputs
outputSpec.help: Flagged-pair output TSVs - one file is produced per flagged pair.

outputSpec.name: plots
outputSpec.label: Plots
outputSpec.help: VAF log2-ratio histogram plots - one file is produced per flagged pair.
